name: GetManyUsers
label: Get Many Users
description: Retrieves multiple Salesforce user records using SOQL.

fields.name: Credential
fields.label: Credential to connect with
fields.description: The credential to connect with (JSON containing InstanceUrl, AccessToken, ApiVersion).

fields.name: ReturnAll
fields.label: Return All
fields.description: If enabled, retrieves all users without limit. If disabled, uses the Limit value.

fields.name: Limit
fields.label: Limit
fields.description: Maximum number of users to retrieve. Only visible when 'Return All' is disabled.

fields.name: Options
fields.label: Options
fields.description: Additional properties to include in the request (e.g., fields to select).

fields.name: Users
fields.label: Users
fields.description: The list of retrieved users as JSON array.

fields.name: Response
fields.label: Response
fields.description: The raw JSON response from Salesforce.
